curated_topic.why_it_matters: This valuation marks a historic turning point in the tech industry, placing a private AI entity in the same valuation tier as global tech giants and signaling the massive capital intensity required for the next phase of AGI development.
curated_topic.hook_angle: We just crossed the Rubicon: OpenAI is reportedly seeking a $1.25 Trillion valuation. Is this the most significant investment in human history, or are we witnessing the peak of the most expensive bubble ever recorded?
